propositions: Cloud probe hardcodes RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES frozenset instead of reading from config, whereas DC reconciler reads resolved_statuses from config.
Tenants with non-standard resolved-status names (e.g., 'Closed', 'Complete', "Won't Do") cannot configure them, causing issues to be misclassified as PRESENT_FILTERED instead of PRESENT_RESOLVED.

Cloud should expose jira.resolved_statuses config key mirroring DC's ReconcilerConfig.resolved_statuses, defaulting to ["Resolved", "Done", "Cancelled"] with _as_str_list coercer and REBAR_JIRA_RESOLVED_STATUSES env override.
classify_probe_response must resolve the status set from config at runtime, falling back to module-level RESOLVED_STATUS_NAMES when config is unset, empty, or malformed.
Empty configured list should fall back to default, not bind an empty set, maintaining stock tenant compatibility.
Custom configured statuses must be consulted instead of merged with defaults, allowing tenants to override the resolved-status set completely.
